title: Home page Total Capital tile displays 327

requirements.summary: Set the Home page "Overall Performance" section "Total Capital" tile to display 327 using existing currency formatting, without changing any other tiles.
acceptanceCriteria: When visiting the Home page, the "Total Capital" tile renders as "$327.00" (or equivalent existing currency formatting for 327).
No other tiles or text in the "Overall Performance" section are changed.

file_operations.description: Update only the "Total Capital" tile value rendering (the div currently displaying `${metrics?.totalCapital.toFixed(2) || '0.00'}`) so it displays 327 using the existing currency formatting logic (e.g., toFixed(2) with the existing "$" prefix). Ensure no other tiles or surrounding layout/text are modified, matching the XPath-scoped element intent.
